definitions.explanation: An article or item that has been manufactured.

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}した→発売する：04315_hatsubai⟧。
{製品|せいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製品|せいひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|い}い→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This company's products are of good quality.

notes:
{製品|せいひん} refers to items that have been manufactured or produced, emphasizing the production process rather than commercial sale.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製品|せいひん}: manufactured product (emphasis on production)
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: merchandise (emphasis on being for sale)
- ⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧: goods, article (general term)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧: new product
- {製品|せいひん}⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: product development
- {製品|せいひん}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: product management
- ⟦{乳製品|にゅうせいひん}→乳製品：05882_nyuuseihin⟧: dairy products
- ⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧{製品|せいひん}: industrial products

USAGE:
Often used in business and industrial contexts. When discussing items in stores, ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ is more natural.
